We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This framed oil painting features an elderly man with a long white beard, wearing a woven straw hat and holding a smoking pipe. The artwork is rendered in a realistic style with visible brush strokes and a soft, muted color palette.

Specifications:
- Medium: Oil on canvas
- Subject: Elderly man with straw hat and smoking pipe
- Style: Realistic with visible brush strokes
- Color Palette: Soft, muted tones
- Frame: Bamboo-style wooden frame with textured brown mat
- Backing: Black paper with hanging wire
- Dimensions: 23.5 x 19.5 inches including frame

Additional Details:
The frame exhibits a rustic, vintage appearance. There are no visible artist signatures or identifying marks on the front.

shipping.policy:
1. Items from our selling location will ship within 5-7 business days (Excluding weekends & Holidays) from the time payment is received. We are working as fast and safely as possible to ensure all orders are shipped out in a timely manner.
2. We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.
6.
Can not combine Buy Now Items (due to system limitations)
6. If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt automatically to combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically prompt please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry some exceptions may be made.
7. Goodwill Industries of Orange County will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with carrier for these types of situations.
8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
9. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

Both specimens are unpolished, used, and without any brand or manufacturer markings. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or display purposes.

This comprehensive lapidary and mineral collection features a diverse array of natural specimens, carved decorative objects, and ancient lithic artifacts. Decorative elements include polished stone eggs, carved mushrooms in rose quartz and selenite, and faceted fluorite. Variety of textures ranging from raw mineral clusters to highly polished decorative eggs

Lithic artifacts show age-appropriate wear and typical knapping patterns. Carved and polished items are structurally sound with minor surface abrasions consistent with handling. description:
Vintage Ken Brown Calligraphy Kit Hunt Speedball 3078 Ink Pen Nibs Textbook
Vintage Ken Brown Calligraphy Kit by Hunt/Speedball, product number 3078. Includes 2 oz. bottle of Hunt/Speedball Super Black India Ink, black Speedball pen holder, four interchangeable Speedball C-series pen nibs, eraser, and 20th Edition Speedball Textbook for pen and brush lettering. Kit also contains practice and tracing paper. Items are gently used with some wear on ink bottle label and box. All components present and functional. Original box includes instructions and calligraphy samples.

General Conditions
All items are used, sold as found, and AS IS with no warranties expressed or implied.
We are not experts in any field; descriptions are based on our best ability using available resources.

Jewelry & Precious Metals
We do not have a gemologist or jeweler on staff. Items are listed to the best of our ability and have not been professionally tested or serviced.
Diamonds vs. moissanite cannot be differentiated by our equipment.
Gems are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester; however, it cannot distinguish natural vs. synthetic stones, and items may have flaws, scratches, or inclusions beyond our ability to identify.
Gold-filled items are only described as marked/stamped or by magnetic properties. Actual karat levels may vary.
Magnetic clasps may be present in precious metal jewelry due to spring mechanisms.
Jewelry testing is only performed upon request, using acid testing. Any post-purchase testing is the buyer’s responsibility, and refunds will not be issued based on authenticity disputes.
Designer items are not authenticated unless specifically stated.
Watches may not include batteries; functionality is not guaranteed.
Lot Listings
Lots may contain mixed items (e.g., jewelry, watches, coins, toys, sports/trading cards, marbles, Legos, etc.).
Items in lots may be unsorted and can include broken, dirty, tangled, or incomplete pieces. Stones, beads, or parts may be missing.
Due to volume, we cannot answer detailed questions about individual pieces within a lot.
Lots are non-refundable and cannot be combined with other purchases.
Authentication
Signatures and autographs are not authenticated unless specified.
Name brand items are not authenticated unless listed as Certified Authentic.
Certified items are authenticated through AuthenticateFirst.com and include a certificate in compliance with ShopGoodwill’s brand policy.
Electronics & Clocks
Tested only for powering on, unless otherwise stated.
Further testing is performed only if equipment is available, and results will be noted in the listing.
Items sold AS IS, with no refunds on functionality.
Shipping
FedEx is the only carrier used.
Shipping weights are calculated by dimensional weight; please check the on-screen shipping calculator before bidding.
Adjustments will only be made if they reduce shipping costs and do not exceed FedEx’s charges.
Maximum combined shipping weight is 20 lbs, per carrier restrictions.
Goodwill of Central Illinois is not responsible for items lost or stolen in transit. Please follow up directly with the carrier for claims.
Placing a bid on any item is an indication that you agree to the terms mentioned above.
